name: coursecraft-lab
description: Create and resume visual-first, project-based courses for practical and academic subjects with verified examples, mirroring labs, assessments, and portable learning contracts.

defaultPrompt: Build my first visual-first course on a subject and begin Lesson 1 with a runnable mirroring lab.
Resume my course from this learning contract and teach the next lesson.
Find authentic graded assignments and examples, then help me prototype the matching skills.
interface.longDescription: Plans and teaches foundational-to-advanced courses through visual explanations, source-verified examples, mirror-build-modify labs, authentic assignments, and exportable cross-session learning contracts. When invoked for an exploratory question, answers that question first without converting it into an unsolicited curriculum.
